name: Players
lead: A room's players and their events: the `players` global, or `room.players`.

functions.name: on_join
functions.description: Calls `fn` when a player arrives: on the globals when a client connects, on a room's table each time a player moves into it.

functions.name: on_leave
functions.description: The same player value on_join had; it can no longer be sent to.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Returns every player in the room.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns the player with this name, or nil.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Returns how many players are in the room.

functions.name: near
functions.description: Who is within a radius of a point, and who is inside a box of blocks.

functions.name: within
functions.description: Returns every player inside a box of blocks, corners included.

functions.name: on_click
functions.description: Calls `fn` on a left or right click; `hit` holds the button and the entity, player, block and face it met.

functions.name: on_sneak
functions.description: Calls `fn` once per sneak press and release; `down` is true on the press.

functions.name: on_slot
functions.description: Calls `fn` when a player picks a hotbar slot, 1..9.

functions.name: on_chat
functions.signature: players.on_chat(fn: (player: Player, text: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
functions.description: Return false and the line is not said.

functions.name: on_pickup
functions.signature: players.on_pickup(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: A stack taken off the ground, and one that landed on it. `player` is nil where the world dropped it, or where they have already left.

functions.name: on_drop
functions.signature: players.on_drop(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: Calls `fn` when a stack lands on the ground; `player` is nil where the world dropped it or they have left.

functions.name: on_death
functions.signature: players.on_death(fn: (player: Player ?, cause: string, message: string, by: Player ?) -> ()) → Connection
functions.description: Calls `fn` when a player dies, with the cause (fall, drown, void, lava, ...) and the line broadcast; `player` is nil once they have left.

functions.name: on_respawn
functions.description: Calls `fn` when a player respawns; `player` is nil once they have left.

functions.name: on_break
functions.signature: players.on_break(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
functions.description: Cancellable. Return `false` to stop it; return nothing to let it through. These are asked *before* the world changes and the engine waits milliseconds for the answer, so they must be quick and must never `task.wait`. Timeout, error, overflow and disabled handlers deny the action. Across packs any `false` wins. See docs/luau-api.md, "saying no".

functions.name: on_place
functions.signature: players.on_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
functions.description: Asks `fn` before a player puts a block down; return false to cancel it. A missed deadline denies the place.

functions.name: on_damage
functions.signature: players.on_damage(fn: (player: Player ?, hit: DamageHit) -> boolean ?) → Connection
functions.description: Asks `fn` before damage lands on a player; return false to refuse it. A missed deadline denies it. A pack's own `player:damage` is not asked about.
